nodes.name: Post to Slack
nodes.notes: Slack auth comes from env vars SLACK_XOXC / SLACK_XOXD (set on the n8n host). No secrets in this file.

parameters.content:
### Setup (self-hosted n8n)
Secrets are read from environment variables — nothing sensitive is in this file, so it is safe to commit.

Set these on your n8n host (its own .env / docker env), then restart n8n:
- **EDCLUB_REFRESH_TOKEN** — edclub `rt` cookie (seed)
- **SLACK_CHANNEL** — channel ID (e.g. C0…)
- **SLACK_XOXC** — Slack xoxc- token
- **SLACK_XOXD** — Slack d cookie (xoxd-)

Then: Import → **Execute Workflow** to test → toggle **Active**.

Slack values expire on logout — update the env vars and restart n8n if posting fails with not_authed.
